name: Unthinking
description: Powers affecting the mind have no effect on [NAME]. It cannot be reasoned with, is unaffected by morale, and will never flee.

name: Carrion Hunger
description: [NAME] prioritizes attacking Incapacitated targets using its Bite. Targets killed this way rise as a Shambler in 3 hours.

name: Rupture
description: When [NAME]'s HP reaches 0, its body bursts in a spray of acidic fluid. Anyone ADJACENT takes 1d6+3 Corrosive damage.

name: Phased
description: [NAME] suffers half damage from all Physical attacks. It can also pass through solid objects unhindered.

name: Levitate
description: [NAME] floats half a meter off the ground at all times. Provoked Attacks against [NAME] suffer Hindrance.

name: Cold Ward
description: [NAME] has +5 Frost Resistance.

name: Consecration Vulnerability
description: [NAME] takes 2x more Divine damage.

name: Slip Inside
description: Standard. [NAME] passes into a living being ADJACENT to it. The target must make a MR check vs. TN 17 or become Confused (TN 18) while [NAME] vanishes into their body. Lasts 3 rounds or until the target suffers 18 or more damage from a single attack. While possessing, [NAME] is immune to damage. Once per battle.

name: Nightmare Face
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME]'s features contort into something unbearable for a moment. The target is Stunned if they cannot resist their fear.

name: Draining Bite
description: Quick. On a successful Frost Touch, [NAME] seizes its victim and sinks teeth in, sending numbing cold through their veins. The target must make a MIGHT check vs. TN 15 or become Diseased. The Disease reduces MIGHT by -2 and is contagious.

name: Dread Presence
description: Any character starting their turn ADJACENT to [NAME] must roll 2d10+MR vs. TN 14 or suffer Hindrance for 1 round.

name: Mesmerizing Stare
description: Standard. Nearby. [NAME] fixes its gaze on a target, holding them in a hypnotic snare. The target must make a MR check vs. TN 18 or be made to believe they fight a weaker double; in reality their body goes limp and their eyes go blank. The illusion has 20 HP and mimics [NAME]'s attacks. Defeating the illusion causes the target to become Incapacitated with no Death rolls. Only an Ally can stabilize them. Allies ADJACENT to the affected target may rally them as a Quick action, granting +1 to all rolls (stacks).

name: Arc Slash
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] rakes its limbs in a wide arc, striking all ADJACENT targets for 3d10+10 damage.

name: Dissolve
description: Movement. [NAME] moves without suffering Provoked Attacks. For an additional 1 Ruin, it may move up to a FAR distance instead of NEARBY.

name: Dark Surge
description: Quick. Nearby. Grant a single undead ally an additional Standard action.

name: Pull
description: Quick. Nearby. [NAME] beckons its target with an irresistible compulsion. The target must make a MR check vs. TN 16 or move one range band closer to [NAME], even without a Movement action. The target is vulnerable to Provoked Attacks during this movement.

name: Blood Mending
description: [NAME] regenerates 15 HP at the start of its turn each round. If [NAME] suffered Divine damage in the previous round, Blood Mending is suppressed that round.

name: Sun Curse
description: If [NAME] starts a turn in direct sunlight, it instantly suffers 40 Fire damage.

name: Holy Weakness
description: [NAME] takes 1.5 times more damage from Divine damage.

name: Relentless Focus
description: Each time [NAME] misses an attack, its AR temporarily increases by +1 (stacking) until a successful attack lands.

name: Predator's Fury
description: Once per battle, [NAME]'s Bite deals maximum damage.

name: Life Scent
description: [NAME] can detect living creatures by heartbeat and blood scent within 200m. Hiding or stealth is ineffective unless both can be masked.

name: Heart Ward
description: If [NAME] fights within 200m of where its heart is stored, all power costs are reduced by 1 Ruin, making 1-Ruin powers free.

name: Flank Strike
description: When attacking a target with one of [NAME]'s allies ADJACENT to it, [NAME] deals an extra 1d6 damage. Melee attacks only.

name: Joint Strike
description: Standard. A precise strike to a vulnerable joint deals 1d8 damage and prevents the target from using powers for 1 round.

name: Vibrate
description: Reaction. [NAME] vibrates at high frequency when targeted, becoming difficult to hit. The attacker suffers Hindrance on that attack.

name: Skitter
description: [NAME]'s small size and quick legs make it an annoying target. All Provoked Attacks against [NAME] suffer Hindrance.

name: Leg Slash
description: Standard. [NAME] slashes at its target's legs, hindering their movement. On a successful hit, the target suffers 1d8+4 damage and is Rooted for 1 round.

name: Haze
description: Quick. [NAME] becomes difficult to track, causing Hindrance on all attacks made against it until the start of its next turn.

name: Flame Burst
description: Standard. Ranged. A ball of fire hurled at the target. On a hit, it explodes for 2d4+3 Fire damage to the target and anyone ADJACENT who fails their Defense roll.

name: Bomb Barrage
description: Standard. [NAME] lobs a cluster of explosives into the air aimed at all enemies. Any enemy that does not move from their current location by the start of [NAME]'s next turn suffers 1d8+2 Fire damage.

name: Unstable Payload
description: If an attack strikes [NAME], the attacking player rolls 1d10 before rolling damage: 1–6: Roll damage as normal. 7–8: A bomb gets knocked loose and explodes, launching [NAME] to a FAR location (GM's choice). 9–10: A bomb in [NAME]'s pack detonates, dealing 2d6 Fire damage to itself and everyone ADJACENT.

name: War Frenzy
description: Quick. [NAME] erupts into a furious rage, gaining +5 damage and +5 Damage Resistance but suffering -3 DR for 1 round.

name: Wide Swing
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] swings in a wide arc through two targets for 2d6+8 damage.

name: Warlord's Aura
description: In the presence of [NAME], all allied Krath on the battlefield regenerate 5 HP per round at the start of their turn. [NAME] does not gain this benefit.

name: Acid Spit
description: Standard. Ranged. Nearby. A spray of corrosive fluid erupts from [NAME]'s mouth. The target suffers 2d6 Corrosive damage and is Poisoned (1d10 True damage at TN 16) for 3 rounds.

name: Heat Burst
description: Standard. [NAME]'s belly glows red as it inflates. At the start of [NAME]'s next turn, all units ADJACENT automatically suffer 2d6 Fire damage. Striking [NAME] while charging also triggers the explosion.

name: Gnat Cloud
description: Standard. Ranged. Far. [NAME]'s wings release a swarm of tiny biting insects that descend on the target. MR check vs. TN 18. On failure, the target suffers 1d10+10 damage and cannot use powers on its next turn.

name: Hive Signal
description: Quick. Ranged. Far. [NAME] emits a burst of rapid clicks toward another of its kind. The targeted ally has their Movement action renewed.

name: Hive Bond
description: At the start of [NAME]'s turn, any ADJACENT allied Scuttlebacks are healed for 5 HP.

name: Mandible Lock
description: Standard. [NAME] uses its powerful jaws to crush and hold its target. The target suffers 1d10+5 damage and must remain ADJACENT for 2 rounds. The target may Contest MIGHT vs. MIGHT at the start of its turn to break free. If [NAME] moves while the target is locked, it is dragged along and subject to Provoked Attacks.

name: Venom Injection
description: Quick. On a successful Mandible Lock, [NAME] may secrete a toxin causing a contagious Disease in the target if they fail a MIGHT check vs. TN 15. The target suffers -1 to MIGHT and AGILITY.

name: Burrowed
description: [NAME] often lurks beneath the surface, waiting to ambush. If [NAME] starts Burrowed, note its location on the battlefield. It may spring up at any time, but uses that round only for emerging, allowing players a chance to react.

name: Tail Sweep
description: Standard. [NAME] snaps its body sharply, bringing its tail around to strike all ADJACENT enemies. Those struck suffer 1d6+4 damage.

name: Essence Feed
description: Standard. [NAME] drops onto a dead or fallen organic entity to feed. A successful Bite must have been made against the target first. While feeding, [NAME] is vulnerable and attacks against it gain +2 to hit. Consumption completes by the start of [NAME]'s next turn, granting a bonus to its next turn.

name: Life Tap
description: [NAME]'s attacks are infused with siphoning energy that heals its allies. When [NAME] deals damage, a single friendly Void target up to FAR away is healed for half the damage dealt.

name: Phase Swap
description: Movement. Far. [NAME] physically swaps positions with another allied Void creature. Does not trigger Provoked Attacks.

name: Void Tendrils
description: Standard. Ranged. Nearby. Both of [NAME]'s hands ignite with violet energy. [NAME] cracks its hands forward in rapid succession, sending tendrils of dark flame at 2 different targets up to NEARBY for 1d10+4 Fire damage each.

name: Mind Intrusion
description: Standard. Ranged. Far. [NAME] floods the target's mind with terrifying imagery, causing them to lose their Movement action as they stumble toward a NEARBY location of the GM's choosing.

name: Creeping Miasma
description: Standard. Ranged. Far. Once per battle, [NAME] sends a slow-moving dark mist toward one target. The miasma advances one range band per round. If it reaches its target, the target must make a MIGHT check vs. TN 16 or become Diseased. Creeping Miasma reduces MIND by -1. The mist continues until [NAME] dies.

name: Soul Binding
description: [NAME] gains full control of any target it slays. The puppet joins combat with all its original abilities and stats, but at half HP.

name: Consume Puppet
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] consumes a puppet and heals for 20 HP.

name: Psychic Pulse
description: Quick. Nearby. Targets MR. Deal 1d10 True damage. Target is Stunned for 1 round.

name: Multi-Limb Attack
description: [NAME] attacks with multiple limbs each turn. At full health [NAME] receives 4 total attacks using Limb Strike (4). For every 25% of max HP missing, [NAME] loses one attack per round and uses the corresponding Limb Strike (#). As it is damaged, attacks become fewer but individually stronger.

name: Engulf
description: Quick. Nearby. When [NAME] Incapacitates a target it may swallow them whole. A swallowed target is stabilized but unreachable to allies unless they kill [NAME] and cut open its digestive cavity. Upon swallowing, [NAME] heals 30 HP and regenerates 5 HP per round per target swallowed. Swallowed targets die in four days if not rescued, losing 25% HP each day.

name: Limb Hurl
description: Quick. Nearby. On a successful Limb Strike, [NAME] may hurl its target a FAR distance. Contest MIGHT vs. MIGHT to resist.

name: Unsettling Presence
description: Any character starting their turn ADJACENT to [NAME] must roll 2d10+MR vs. TN 12 or suffer -2 to AR for 1 round.

name: Heightened Perception
description: All Stealth checks suffer Hindrance when made within 20m of [NAME].

name: Thrash
description: Standard. [NAME] thrashes all its limbs wildly in every direction. Everyone ADJACENT or NEARBY must make a Defense roll. Those struck suffer 1d20+5 damage and are Staggered for 1 round.

name: Dark Mending
description: [NAME] regenerates 8 HP at the start of its turn each round.

name: Death Throes
description: When [NAME] drops to 0 or below HP, it loses control and lashes out in a final frenzy, striking all ADJACENT enemies for 1d10+4 damage if they fail their Defense roll.

name: Greater Dark Mending
description: [NAME] regenerates 10 HP at the start of its turn each round.

name: Arm Swipe
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] sweeps its massive arm in a wide arc, striking all ADJACENT enemies for its Melee Attack damage.

name: Grip Lock
description: Standard. Adjacent. Seize an ADJACENT target and crush them for 1d8+8 damage. They cannot use Movement or make Provoked Attacks while locked. The target may Contest MIGHT vs. MIGHT on their turn to break free. Targets still locked at the start of their turn automatically suffer another 1d8+8 damage.

name: Death Seep
description: Upon death, [NAME] disgorges a thick black fluid onto an ADJACENT target (usually the one who struck the killing blow). If the target fails their Defense roll, they must make a MIGHT check vs. TN 16 or become Diseased. Death Seep reduces PRESENCE and AGILITY by 2 and is contagious.

name: Communal Chant
description: Standard. [NAME] joins hands and begins a rhythmic chant. A soft aura expands outward. If not interrupted by the start of its next turn, up to 3 allies on the battlefield are healed for 10 HP each.

name: Strength Surge
description: Standard. Far. A single allied target gains +5 damage on their next attack. The recipient visibly swells with enhanced strength for a moment.

name: Restorative Light
description: Standard. Far. Instantly heal an ally or self for 20 HP.

name: Sky Drop
description: Standard. [NAME] forgoes its Standard action to crouch and launch upward. DR increases by +2 during the wind-up. At the start of its next turn, [NAME] uses its Standard action to drop on any target on the battlefield. Immune to Provoked Attacks during the drop. On a hit, gains +2 to AR and deals 2d8+4 damage.

name: Lift
description: Provoked Attacks against [NAME] when it moves away from enemies suffer Hindrance.

name: Overclock
description: Quick. Target a single ADJACENT automaton. The automaton gains +2 to damage, AR, and DR. The bonus passively stacks by +1 each round while the source remains ADJACENT. Only one target per source; only one source per target.

name: Defensive Startup
description: [NAME] gains +3 DR against the first attack it receives in a battle.

name: Field Repair
description: Standard. Target a single ADJACENT automaton. The automaton is healed for 15 HP.

name: Unit Cohesion
description: When two or more Cogbots move away from an enemy simultaneously, their DR against Provoked Attacks is increased by +4 for that Movement.

name: Drill Mode
description: Standard. Spend 1 round to spin up [NAME]'s weapon arm to high speed. All subsequent attacks pierce armor and ignore AV. Any damage taken during the spin-up phase cancels Drill Mode. Once fully activated, it remains on for the rest of the battle. Players should be warned of the wind-up.

name: Pack Surge
description: For every [NAME] on the battlefield, [NAME]'s damage increases by +1.

name: Dying Strike
description: When [NAME] suffers a killing blow, it makes an instant Melee Attack against an ADJACENT target before dying.

name: Marks of the Dark Pact
description: A [NAME] may bear only one mark. Mark of the Devourer: Quick. 1 Ruin. [NAME]'s next attack is fueled by consuming hunger; [NAME] heals for twice the damage inflicted. Mark of the Flame: Passive. Infernal fire burns within [NAME]; when it dies, everyone ADJACENT automatically suffers 1d8 Fire damage. Replaces Dying Strike. Mark of the Snare: Passive. [NAME] is emboldened by others' pain; when a PC becomes Incapacitated, [NAME] heals 10 HP and regains its Standard action.

name: Armored Hide
description: [NAME] uses its AV as universal Damage Resistance. All damage types (except True damage) it takes are reduced by its AV.

name: Weak Point
description: [NAME]'s central eye is its most fragile organ. Striking it directly deals 1.5x damage. The eye's DR is 23.

name: Cold Ray
description: Standard. Far. An icy beam lances from [NAME]'s eye, Rooting its target for 1 round and dealing 2d8+8 Frost damage.

name: Heat Ray
description: Standard. Far. A blazing beam erupts from [NAME]'s eye. Deal 1d12+8 Fire damage to the target and any ADJACENT enemies who fail their Defense roll.

name: Force Ray
description: Standard. Far. A shimmering beam blasts the target with concussive force, dealing 1d12+10 damage and displacing them 1 range band away.

name: Petrify Ray
description: Standard. Far. A pale beam solidifies its target. If struck, the target must overcome a MIGHT check vs. TN 13 or turn to stone. For every 25% HP the target is missing, the TN increases by +2. Victims remain petrified until [NAME] is slain.

name: Root Mending
description: [NAME] regenerates 20 HP at the start of its turn. In sunlight or rain, this amount increases by +10.

name: Tinder
description: [NAME] takes 2x more Fire damage. When [NAME] suffers Fire damage, Root Mending is suppressed at the start of its next turn.

name: Ground Pound
description: Standard. [NAME] raises and slams a massive limb, sending a shockwave outward. Deals 1d8+5 damage to all enemies up to NEARBY and drags all NEARBY enemies to become ADJACENT to [NAME].

name: Spike Coat
description: Quick. Razor barbs burst from every part of [NAME]'s body. While active, melee attackers suffer 1d10 return damage. Also grants +3 Armour Penetration. Lasts until the start of [NAME]'s next turn.

name: Acid Bite
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] bites into its target and releases a corrosive enzyme through glands in its mouth. Deal 1d20+4 damage immediately; the target is Poisoned (1d12 True damage at TN 17) for 3 rounds.

name: Slick Hide
description: Quick. [NAME] secretes a thick, foul-smelling oil all over its body. Gains +4 DR against all Melee attacks until the start of its next turn.

name: Signal Attack
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] leaps onto a target and releases a burst of pheromones. All [NAME]s on the battlefield are whipped into a frenzy, dealing +4 damage against the tagged target for 1 round.

name: Waterborn
description: When fighting in water at least 1m deep, [NAME]'s Movement action carries it two range bands instead of one and Provoked Attacks against it suffer Hindrance.

name: Leap Strike
description: Standard. Nearby Only. [NAME] crouches low before launching itself at its target, descending viciously for 1d12+15 damage. Ignores all Provoked Attacks while airborne.

name: Burning Shell
description: When struck in melee, [NAME] deals 4 Fire damage to all ADJACENT enemies.

name: Combustion Death
description: When [NAME] receives a killing blow, its body twists as veins of fire glow beneath its skin. At the start of its next turn, [NAME] explodes for 1d10+5 Fire damage to all ADJACENT targets. While this is occurring, the dying [NAME] can still be displaced by movement powers.

name: Keen Scent
description: [NAME] tracks by smell with precision and cannot be surprised. Immune to powers requiring distraction or surprise. Can detect hidden or stealthed creatures up to VERY FAR.

name: Flame Proof
description: [NAME] is immune to all Fire damage.

name: Frost Vulnerability
description: [NAME] takes 2x more Frost damage.

name: Airborne
description: [NAME] is immune to Provoked Attacks.

name: Banshee Cry
description: Standard. Nearby. A piercing wail tears through the air, disorienting the target and those ADJACENT. All affected must make a MR check vs. TN 14 or become Staggered. When used on a target that is ADJACENT, failure also deals 1d8+4 damage.

name: Fell Stitch
description: Quick. Adjacent. Dark energy seals wounds and snaps bones back into place. Instantly heal the target for 20 HP.

name: Evasive Step
description: Reaction. When a Melee attack misses [NAME], it may freely move to a NEARBY distance without triggering Provoked Attacks.

name: Pack Flanker
description: [NAME] distracts enemies to create openings for its allies. [NAME] gains +1 to AR and damage against its target for every additional [NAME] that is ADJACENT to the target.

name: Hidden Tail
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] reveals a concealed tail and whips it at an unsuspecting enemy. Deals 1d4+3 damage and Staggers the target for 1 round.

name: Stalkers
description: [NAME] is skilled at avoiding detection in order to always strike first. Attempts to detect lurking [NAME] suffer Hindrance.

name: Target Marked
description: Quick. [NAME] coordinates with allies, marking a high-priority target. A visible indicator marks the target. Marked targets suffer an additional +3 damage when successfully attacked by a [NAME]. Only one target can be Marked at a time. Lasts until end of battle.

name: Breakout
description: Movement. Using exceptional speed, [NAME] moves through and away from enemies without triggering Provoked Attacks.

name: Last Draw
description: Standard. A powerful shot deals 2d6+5 damage but destroys [NAME]'s bow, leaving it melee-only for the rest of the encounter.

name: Grief Rage
description: If the Keth rider is killed while [NAME] is still alive, [NAME] flies into a rampage, becoming immune to all status effects and gaining an extra 1d12 on all damage rolls. [NAME] will relentlessly pursue its rider's killer and nothing will stop it short of death.

name: Fang Lock
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] chomps down and clamps onto its target. The target suffers 1d10+4 damage and is Rooted for 1 round.

name: Pack Bond
description: When attacking a target with another [NAME] ADJACENT to it, [NAME] gains +1 AR and +1 damage for each additional [NAME] ADJACENT to the target.

name: Shield Companion
description: Reaction. When ADJACENT to a Duskborn Taskmaster, [NAME] may leap in to intercept a successful attack aimed at the Taskmaster, taking the hit instead.

name: Taskmaster's Lash
description: Quick. Nearby. [NAME]'s whip cracks across the back of one of the Duskborn Imps, leaving a burning mark. The Imp grows visibly larger as its body strains to accommodate the enhancement. That Imp gains +3 to AR and damage for the rest of battle. Stackable indefinitely.

name: Step It Up
description: Standard. Far. [NAME] barks urgent orders at one of its Imps. The Imp may take another Standard action if it already has one, or take 2 Standard actions if it hasn't acted yet. Bonus is lost at round's end if unused.

name: Ram Strike
description: Standard. Nearby. [NAME]'s vehicle grinds with building momentum before slamming into a target. Takes 1 round to prepare. On impact, the target takes 3d10+10 damage and is knocked a NEARBY distance away.

name: Mass Command
description: Standard. [NAME] lets out a bellowing call that charges all Imps on the battlefield. All Imps receive the Step It Up bonus.

name: Swallow
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] attempts to swallow a Medium or smaller creature whole. On success, the creature suffers 1d12+10 Corrosive damage immediately and at the start of each of its turns while inside. The creature cannot use Movement and attacks from inside where [NAME]'s AV is 0. Dealing 30 or more total damage from inside frees the creature and deals 15 True damage to [NAME]. Only one creature can be swallowed at a time. If the creature dies inside, [NAME] heals 40 HP.

name: Crush
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] slams its bulk into all ADJACENT enemies, dealing 1d8+12 damage.

name: Acid Stream
description: Standard. Ranged. Very Far. A stream of corrosive saliva is ejected forcefully at a target. Deals 1d8+7 Corrosive damage and reduces the target's AV by 2 until the end of battle. Reduction stacks.

name: Ground Pulse
description: [NAME] can detect any creature moving on the ground within 2 km. No amount of stealth negates Ground Pulse as long as the creature is in contact with the earth.

name: Exposed Moment
description: When [NAME] uses Mandible Crush or Swallow, its AV drops to 0 for the first successful attack afterward as its head is momentarily vulnerable.
